stories.title: Spor sahasının altından 2 bin yıllık hazine çıktı

en.title: 2,000-year-old treasure unearthed beneath sports field
en.summary: Excavation work at an old sports field in Singen, Germany revealed an unexpected archaeological discovery of ancient artifacts dating back 2,000 years.

en.title: Illegal betting operation in Mersin: 30 arrests
en.summary: An illegal betting operation in Mersin resulted in 49 suspects being detained, with 30 of them placed under arrest.

stories.title: Emniyet kararnamesi Resmi Gazete'de yayımlandı: 39 ilin emniyet müdürü değişti

en.title: Security directorate decree published in Official Gazette: police chiefs changed in 39 provinces
en.summary: New appointments were made to police chief positions in 39 provinces following a decree signed by President Erdoğan and published in the Official Gazette.

stories.title: 7 ilde yasa dışı bahis operasyonu: 25 tutuklama

en.title: Illegal betting operation in 7 provinces: 25 arrests
en.summary: An illegal betting operation centered in Kocaeli across 7 provinces resulted in 25 arrests out of 32 detained suspects, with authorities identifying 460 million Turkish lira in financial transfers.

stories.title: ABD vize vermedi: BM Genel Kurulu'ndan 'Mahmud Abbas' kararı

en.title: US denies visa: UN General Assembly decision on 'Mahmud Abbas'
en.summary: The UN General Assembly voted to allow Palestinian President Mahmud Abbas to address the assembly via pre-recorded video message after the US denied him a visa. The decision passed with support from 152 countries, while 3 voted against and 4 abstained.

stories.title: Emniyet kararnamesi yayımlandı: Gülistan Doku soruşturmasında ifade veren Emniyet Müdürü merkeze alındı

en.title: Security directorate decree published: Police Chief who testified in Gülistan Doku investigation transferred to headquarters
en.summary: A provincial police chiefs decree was published in the Official Gazette. Yalova Police Chief Yılmaz Delen, who testified as a witness in the Gülistan Doku investigation, was transferred to headquarters, while Deputy Police Director General Mahmut Çorumlu was appointed to lead the Police Directorate.

stories.title: Aydın merkezli 7 ilde yasa dışı bahis operasyonunda 27 zanlı tutuklandı

en.title: 27 suspects arrested in illegal betting operation across 7 provinces centered in Aydın
en.summary: Law enforcement conducted an illegal betting operation across seven provinces based in Aydın, resulting in the arrest of 27 suspects.

stories.title: ABD'nin vize verdiği Mahmud Abbas, BM Genel Kurulu'na video ile hitap edecek

en.title: Mahmud Abbas, denied US visa, to address UN General Assembly via video
en.summary: Palestinian President Mahmud Abbas, who was denied a US visa, is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly in New York through video conference.

stories.title: İstanbul adliyelerinde yargı süreçlerine müdahale soruşturması: 5 gözaltı

en.title: Investigation into judicial process interference in Istanbul courts: 5 detained
en.summary: Five suspects, including an alleged crime organization leader named Musa Ş. and a lawyer, were detained in an investigation into allegations of judicial interference for profit across different Istanbul courts. Several judges and prosecutors were reported to relevant authorities.

stories.title: Son Dakika... Usta oyuncu Gülsen Tuncer hayatını kaybetti

en.title: Veteran actress Gülsen Tuncer has passed away
en.summary: Gülsen Tuncer, an 81-year-old acclaimed actress known for her role as Arsen Ziyagil in the television series Aşk-ı Memnu, has died.

en.title: Father of Narin Güran marches toward the Presidency
en.summary: Arif Güran, father of 8-year-old Narin Güran who died in Diyarbakır, is walking from Diyarbakır to Ankara to seek clarification regarding his daughter's death.

stories.title: Bakan Çiftçi yeni operasyonlar için tarih verdi: Borsa İstanbul’da manipülasyon soruşturması

en.title: Interior Minister Çiftçi sets timeline for new operations: Istanbul Stock Exchange manipulation investigation
en.summary: Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi indicated that new operations will continue while manipulation investigations at the Istanbul Stock Exchange remain ongoing.

stories.title: TÜİK Başkan Yardımcılığına Cihat Erce İşbaşar atandı

en.title: Cihat Erce İşbaşar appointed to Turkish Statistical Institute Deputy Chairmanship
en.summary: Turkey's President Erdoğan signed a decree published in the Official Gazette appointing Cihat Erce İşbaşar to the Deputy Chairmanship position at the Turkish Statistical Institute.

stories.title: 39 ilin emniyet müdürü değişti: Yeni kararname Resmi Gazete'de

en.title: Police chiefs changed in 39 provinces: New decree in Official Gazette
en.summary: A new decree was published in the Official Gazette implementing personnel changes across 69 positions in Turkey's police organization, including replacements of police chiefs in 39 provinces.

en.title: The People's Fish: Mackerel
en.summary: Mackerel fishing season begins in September, providing an affordable and nourishing fish that has historically sustained Istanbul's population during periods of hardship.

en.title: 'Çorum's Greatest Table' set up in Bodrum
en.summary: Regional specialties from Çorum, known for its deep gastronomic heritage, were showcased at a festival in Bodrum while the region pursues UNESCO Creative Cities Network recognition.

en.title: We entered the 80s and can't get out
en.summary: Fashion trends from the 1980s are cyclically returning to popularity. Classic pieces such as low-rise pants, ballet flats, quilted fabrics, and parachute pants reappear approximately every 20 to 30 years with new appeal.
